name: contractcraft
description: contractcraft L3: contract lifecycle window (pipeline board, contract page with risks, redline, seals, terms) on the craft-biz-ui suite frame.

tools.name: contract_status
tools.description: Counts by status, templates, sealed contracts, whether the seal key exists.

tools.name: contract_template_add
tools.description: Add a template (or a new version of it). Placeholders {{name}} must match the declared variables exactly.

tools.name: contract_template_show
tools.description: One template with body and variables.

tools.name: contract_draft
tools.description: Create a draft from a template (values fill its variables; typos and missing required values are errors) or from your own text. Returns a quick risk count.

tools.name: contract_list
tools.description: Contracts with status, allowed next statuses and the next deadline.

tools.name: contract_show
tools.description: One contract: text (current or a version), versions, status history, seals, risk findings, next deadline.

tools.name: contract_edit
tools.description: New text version (draft only). Returns the redline stats and risk delta.

tools.name: contract_terms
tools.description: Term data for deadlines: start, initial_months, renewal_months (0 = fixed term), notice_months, annual_value. Fixed after execution.

tools.name: contract_transition
tools.description: Move along draft -> under_review -> pending_signature -> executed -> terminated/expired (cancelled from any open state). Executing needs a seal of the current version and sends contract.executed to gaincraft.

tools.name: contract_seal
tools.description: Seal the current version: SHA-256 of the text + Ed25519 signature. Tamper evidence, not a legal e-signature.

tools.name: contract_verify
tools.description: Check all seals against the stored text; with path, check that a file is byte-identical to the sealed text.

tools.name: contract_redline
tools.description: Line diff between two versions (default: previous vs current) plus which risk findings were added or removed.

tools.name: contract_risk_scan
tools.description: Deterministic DE/EN clause scan (liability, indemnity, auto-renewal, foreign venue/law, missing DPA, penalties, unilateral changes, exclusivity). Optional TOML rule file. Not legal advice.

tools.name: contract_render
tools.description: Write the text as md (byte-identical to the sealed text), typ (Typst source) or pdf (needs the Typst CLI; fails clearly without it).

tools.name: contract_deadlines
tools.description: Notice deadlines and term ends of executed contracts within N days (default 90). emit=true sends each once to taskcraft as contract.deadline.

tools.name: contract_drain_inbox
tools.description: Open one draft employment contract per hirecraft candidate.hired event. A repeated candidate is skipped.

tools.name: contract_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY database with labelled demo templates and three contracts (executed, risky draft, renegotiated).
